title: Smart Data Models - SunSpec Information Models - common
description: Common. All SunSpec compliant devices must include this as the first model. SunSpec Information Model 1 (common), sunspec/models v2026-04-20. Point names kept verbatim; values are given already scaled, so the scale-factor (*_SF), padding and model framing (ID, L) points are left out.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:common:<Mn>-<SN> (manufacturer and serial number of the device).

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'common'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

Mn.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_1.json#Mn'. Manufacturer. Well known value registered with SunSpec for compliance. SunSpec type string. Static value (does not change during operation). Mandatory in SunSpec. Standards: IEEE 1547-2018.

Md.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_1.json#Md'. Model. Manufacturer specific value (32 chars). SunSpec type string. Static value (does not change during operation). Mandatory in SunSpec. Standards: IEEE 1547-2018.

Opt.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_1.json#Opt'. Options. Manufacturer specific value (16 chars). SunSpec type string. Static value (does not change during operation).

Vr.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_1.json#Vr'. Version. Manufacturer specific value (16 chars). SunSpec type string. Static value (does not change during operation). Standards: IEEE 1547-2018.

SN.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_1.json#SN'. Serial Number. Manufacturer specific value (32 chars). SunSpec type string. Static value (does not change during operation). Mandatory in SunSpec. Standards: IEEE 1547-2018.

DA.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/sunspec/models/blob/v2026-04-20/json/model_1.json#DA'. Device Address. Modbus device address. This point is mandatory for all SunSpec RTU devices and, for those devices, they must support values from 1-247. SunSpec type uint16. Read-write setting.
